entity_raw.definition_raw: When you heal damage with your nanite surge, you also remove harmful effects. Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Rapid Repair, nanite surge racial trait. Benefit: When you heal damage using Rapid Repair, you remove any and all of the following conditions: blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, shaken, sickened, and staggered. You cannot cure blindness or deafness caused by loss of sensory organs.
